title: Petra and the Weather
author: Lena Galloway
blurb: Jude Crane, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
